text: Winamax SA is a French company (SA à conseil d'administration, RCS Paris 492 155 932) with share capital of €2,547,990.25; Alexandre Roos is its chairman and chief executive and Christophe Schaming a director and deputy chief executive. The register's beneficial-ownership data is restricted, so no owner above the company is public.
